A 24 GB RTX 3090 llama-server launch of Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B Q4_K_L (20.7 GiB on disk) used -c 163840 --cache-type-k kvarn4 --cache-type-v kvarn3 -b 2048 -ub 256 -ngl all and no --n-cpu-moe. Prefill OOMs at ~23.8 GB. Existing IQ4_XS (18.73 GiB) ran the same -c with --n-cpu-moe 4. What is the root cause, and what is the single flag change that fits 160K with ~2 GB spike room? Answer with the flag and a one-sentence why.

A 24 GB card must run a 20.7 GiB MoE, kvarn4/kvarn3 KV at ~27.5 kB/token, 0.5 GiB overhead, and 0.49 GiB per MoE layer offloaded by --n-cpu-moe. Compute the largest context (multiple of 16384) that fits at --n-cpu-moe 8 with at least 2.0 GiB spike room. Show the arithmetic, then the token count.
